description: This source file defines the PdfNamedDestinations class, which manages named destinations in a PDF document as per the document catalog’s /Dest entry. It provides methods to list all destination names, check for existence of a destination by name, and retrieve destinations.

classes.name: PdfNamedDestinations
classes.description: Represents named destinations within a PDF document, providing access to destination names and retrieval of specific destinations.

methods.name: Names
methods.description: Property returning all the destination names stored in the document.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a destination with a specific name exists in the collection.

methods.name: GetDestination
methods.description: Retrieves the destination array associated with a given name, if it exists.
